description: PRTR: Waste and Wastewater Management is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Protection Agency. The PRTR Waste and Wastewater Management sector includes the following activities: (a) Installations for the recovery or disposal of hazardous waste receiving 10 tonnes per day. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Protection Agency. Its tags are actual pollutant releases (pollutant release and transfer register), animal waste, emission to air, emission to water, environment. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
